mapper.sql: a.*, s.name AS supplier_name, o.order_no, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, d.doc_no AS trade_doc_no, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM scm_asn_item i WHERE i.asn_id = a.id) AS total_qty

FROM scm_asn a LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = a.supplier_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = a.order_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = a.trade_doc_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled FROM scm_asn_item i LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.asn_id = #{asnId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO scm_asn_item (asn_id, order_item_id, material_id, qty, batch_no, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.asnId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.batchNo}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_asn SET status = #{to}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
